detail.longDescription: I think I can say, at least for me, why Claude's writing is so freaking awful, even when it's completely correct. Claude writes technical docs that are true in the same sense that it is true my best friend is a collection of specialized tissues known as "organs" and blah blah blah - and nothing else. Don't ever forget the trailing negation, it is omitted never. Another take: Claude writes like your best friend describing a great first date. "Ok we were going to meet at 8 - did I mention it was Friday? Right, 8 oclock at the Italian place and no place else. During dinner he accidentally spit out some food, but I thought i was funny! That's because we were laughing so hard after we discovered we were both from Omaha. That was before dinner, during drinks, when we couldn't get rid of Alfred. His place really needs a deep cleaning!" Perhaps with all of the hope for an LLM-authored movie, we try for something non-linear?
